_: The wake gate's rules (gate.cjs). Regular expressions, case-insensitive for words. An operator's own additions go in gate-rules.local.json beside the gate, which an update never touches; keys there add to these. Tuned from the measuring week.
_release: release: the window opens only when the bare production marker (never a compound like Production-scale) and an action-under-way verb share a sentence that is not a question and carries no negation before the verb (dev operator, 2026-09-22, three cases: "Production is release", "promotion to Production" in an ask, "Production-scale data ... without ... starting"). Production words alone still wake by rule 1. A dot between digits does not end the sentence (2026-10-19: 'promoting release 1.0.0.707 to Production' opened no window).
release: \b(production|prod|octopus)\b(?![-\w])(?:[^.?]|(?<=\d)\.(?=\d)){0,100}\b(start\w*|running|in progress|in flight|under way|dispatch\w*|kicked off|triggered|applying|applied|deploying|promoting|executing|go ahead with|proceed(ing)? with)\b
claims: \b(landed and verified|verified on|merged to main|all (tests|checks) pass(ed|ing)?)\b

quietDrop.watcher replacement: ^(?:(?:fmwatch|boardwatch|stwatch)\.cjs: replaced a leftover copy \(pid \d+\)|gate\.cjs: replaced (?:a leftover|an orphaned) gate \(pid \d+, source [\w-]+\)|LIGHTHOUSE \| replaced the previous sweep \(pid \d+\)(?: that was still running)?; single instance kept)$

routineReplies: ^FM REPLY [^|]*\|\s*(shipshape|all clear|nothing (needed|to do|new|changed)|no action needed)[.!;, ]*(nothing (needed|to do)[.!]*)?\s*(\[exact text saved: [^\]]*\]\s*)?(\[key [^\]]*\])?\s*$
